question: Does the frozen-OlmoEarth cache-reuse advantage measured on Sen12Landslides (M65: P4 .2722 vs best raw .1966, 7/8 regions vs best raw arm) reproduce on a second and third task with a different domain, under the identical recipe and geographic leave-one-region-out protocol?
selection_rules_fixed_before_data: pixel masks (segmentation) preferred; tile labels only as head sensitivity
contract already solved (rslearn-format or OlmoEarth-evaluated public dataset)
domain priority: disaster > land change > static land cover

task2_primary.name: satlas_solar_farm
task2_primary.input: Sentinel-2, 4 timesteps, 12 bands (model view B02 B03 B04 B08 B05 B06 B07 B8A B11 B12 B01 B09)
task2_primary.label: binary segmentation mask
task2_primary.geographic_grouping: UTM zone (fallback: continent), balanced into 8 folds
task2_primary.why: global coverage gives real geographic shift; binary segmentation matches the landslide recipe exactly; anthropogenic, season-independent target widens the domain axis

task3.name: Sen1Floods11
task3.source: https://github.com/cloudtostreet/Sen1Floods11 (also in OlmoEarth and PANGAEA evaluation suites)
task3.input: Sentinel-1 + Sentinel-2, single date (requires single-timestep handling in the cache extractor)
task3.label: flood segmentation mask
task3.why: disaster domain with mandatory radar; tests whether cache reuse survives a water-body task

head_sensitivity.name: forest_loss_driver
head_sensitivity.source: olmoearth_run_data/forest_loss_driver (do not modify those two files; copy); partner tar
head_sensitivity.label: 10-class tile classification
head_sensitivity.why: before/after structure isomorphic to landslides; classification head only

protocol_identical_to_sen12.recipe: 40 epoch, BCEWithLogits, pos_weight=neg/pos capped 50, Adam lr 1e-3 wd 1e-4, batch 16, best epoch on the fold's val region

verdict_rule.reproduces: P4 beats the best raw arm in >= 5 of 8 folds
verdict_rule.domain_dependent: otherwise; the paper narrows the reuse claim to sparse natural-change tasks and reports this as a boundary, not a failure

few_shot_followup.excluded: A2 CacheTune family (MS-94 stop rule applies across tasks)
few_shot_followup.manifest_rule: same as cachetune_pt0 (event/component grouping, 10 km blocks, 3 km buffer, >= 40% positive support)

cost_estimate.cache_extraction: one pass over all tiles x 4 timesteps on GPU1
cost_estimate.training_runs: 8 folds x 3 arms x 3 seeds = 72 runs; ~16 min each on Sen12 => ~19 GPU hours, x1.5 under sharing

step0_parallel_cpu: Korea preflight without opening labels: AIHUB_CUBE_V2_CONTRACT 40-tile pilot gate, model_view_10band, keep M10 spatial split
forbidden_claims: OlmoEarth is superior to all GeoFMs (Prithvi/Clay/TerraMind not run)

addendum_v1_2026_09_03_fewshot_confirmat.why: The registered Task-2 plan replicated M65 (full-data P2/P3/P4) but did not replicate the new headline (MS-96/97 few-shot decision). Reviewers would note the label-budget decision rests on one task.
addendum_v1_2026_09_03_fewshot_confirmat.status_at_registration: solar_farm.tar downloaded and SHA-sealed (e08e5349a51ba057f4a27cd6878349cb31f97c17a253f437dabe627d905bd39f); archive not yet inspected; no label statistics viewed

design.folds: all 8 geographic folds; if compute forces a cut, the first 5 folds in the sealed fold order are used and this is decided before any Task-2 metric is read

success_rule.replicates: A1 - A4w >= +0.01 in >= 6/8 folds at K=5 (>= 4/5 if 5 folds) AND same direction at K=20
success_rule.fails: otherwise the label-budget decision is reported as landslide-specific; no relaxation

addendum_v1_2026_09_03_fewshot_confirmat.prerequisite_full_data_arms: source P4/P2 decoders per fold must first be trained under the Sen12 recipe (this is the M65-style step) — reported, but the paper headline for Task-2 is the few-shot replication
addendum_v1_2026_09_03_fewshot_confirmat.independence_note: Solar Farm is an official OlmoEarth partner task: strong for the Ai2 link, not a fully independent external test. A public external task (Sen1Floods11 or an EarthShift split) is registered as Task-3 for independence.

A3_encoder_peft_registered_2026_09_03.arm: A3 = OlmoEarth v1 Base encoder PEFT (LoRA on attention q/v or rslearn APLA; rank 8 primary) fine-tuned on the same K support tiles from raw pixels, then re-embedded; decoder from A1 protocol
A3_encoder_peft_registered_2026_09_03.purpose: closes 'reuse vs re-embed': today's 'retrain' arm is raw UNet, so the question 'why not adapt the OlmoEarth encoder itself?' is open

interpretation_fixed.A3_slightly_wins: re-embedding only when cost is justified; report accuracy-vs-recompute frontier (raw bytes, GPU s, cache invalidation)
interpretation_fixed.A3_clearly_wins: shift the paper to finding where cache validity breaks

A3_encoder_peft_registered_2026_09_03.scope: development folds first (china, chimanimani), K=20, 3 seeds; confirmatory only if gate rules are met; costs must be reported per arm
